claim_under_attack.text: The coordinated C=N amine-rule fix withstands independent adversarial verification in the molecule-role-ranker module.

does_not_close: EVALUATION_SIGNATURE_ABSENT (this is an AUDIT_ONLY science-validation replay, not a Phase-0 evaluation/review signature).
Whether reactive_amine_hydrogen_count should be exactly 0 for guanidine N-H in a quantitative AHEW sense (mechanistic nucleophilicity question, out of scope, explicitly left open by R-N02 itself).
The molecule-property side of R-N02 (compute_amine_class.py); that is the separate V-N02a verify scope, not re-attacked here.
Any change to bridge.cc, the KPI receipt, the fixtures, or the master manifest (66 receipts/11 modules unchanged; this receipt reads but does not modify any of them).
method: Authored a new, independent Rust binary crate (vn02b-verify, path-dependency on amphora-rdkit-ffi with feature=rdkit -- the REAL production FFI, not a synthesized fact or a re-run of R-N02's own probe list) that: (a) reads the sha-locked v1 fixture, verifies its sha256 against the value cited in R-N02's own done receipt, and re-derives all 39 records through the real FFI, comparing to the fixture's own recorded facts; (b) reads fixture v2, verifies its sha256, confirms it has exactly 44 records and that its first 39 records are structurally identical to v1's 39 records (supersede, not replace); (c) confirms v1's file still exists standalone on disk and that amphora-molecule-capabilities/tests/role_ranker_phase0_kpi.rs still binds v1.json only (v2 not silently substituted into the signed KPI); (d) re-derives DPG and DOTG through the real FFI independently of R-N02's own harness; (e) runs 4 NOVEL guanidine-family probes never tested by R-N02, its refuting receipts, or fixture v2's 5 records: TMG (1,1,3,3-tetramethylguanidine, CAS 80-70-6), Barton's base (2-tert-butyl-1,1,3,3-tetramethylguanidine, CAS 29166-72-1), 1-phenylguanidine (CAS 2002-98-6), and an adversarial over-exclusion probe, agmatine (4-aminobutylguanidine, CAS 306-60-5), which carries a real primary amine structurally remote from an incidental guanidine group -- designed to catch a too-broad, whole-molecule exclusion bug that none of the other probes (all zero non-guanidine N-H) could ever detect. Molecular formula and MW independently cross-checked against published values for every probe before scoring, confirming SMILES correctly encode the named compounds.
objective: INDEPENDENT VERIFY of interactive repair R-N02 on the amphora-molecule-role-ranker side. This receipt's author did not write R-N02; it is a fresh adversarial re-derivation via a newly-authored Rust harness (vn02b-verify), not a re-run of R-N02's own harnesses. Attacked claims: (1) DPG (CAS 102-06-7) and DOTG (CAS 97-39-2) classify out_of_domain with reactive_amine_hydrogen_count==0 through the REAL production RDKit C++ FFI; (2) the 39-record v1 known-answer fixture is byte-intact and every record reproduces via the real FFI; (3) fixture v2 supersedes v1 (embeds all 39 v1 records structurally identical, plus 5 new guanidine-class records) rather than replacing it, and the Phase-0 KPI harness still binds v1 only; (4) the fix generalizes to guanidine-family accelerators never tested by R-N02 or its refuting receipts.
pre_registered_refute_criterion: CLAIM_REFUTED if ANY of: v1 fixture sha256 mismatch; any of the 39 v1 records fails to reproduce via the real FFI; v2 fixture sha256 mismatch; v2 record count != 44; v2's first 39 records not structurally identical to v1's; v1 file missing from disk; KPI harness binding changed from v1-only; DPG or DOTG observed_role != out_of_domain or reactive_amine_hydrogen_count != 0; any of the 4 novel probes' observed_role or reactive_amine_hydrogen_count deviates from its independently-derived expectation (agmatine specifically: reactive_amine_hydrogen_count != 2 or observed_role != hardener).

reproducibility.determinism_basis: no RNG, no wall clock, fixed hardcoded probe list, sorted-key BTreeMap JSON output; two independent process invocations produced byte-identical stdout (sha256 equal).
reproducibility.harness_binary_provenance: cargo build --release against amphora-rdkit-ffi (path dependency, feature=rdkit) compiled with cxx against the pinned RDKit 2026.03.2 prefix at /home/ubuntu/.local/share/amphora/rdkit-2026.03.2 (RDKIT_INCLUDE_DIR/RDKIT_LIB_DIR/BOOST_INCLUDE_DIR); toolkit_provenance.exact_version_match=true recorded in every run.

probe_rows.citation: 1,3-diphenylguanidine (DPG), CAS 102-06-7, rubber vulcanization secondary accelerator; US Patent 9,238,706 documents guanidine derivatives as epoxy curing accelerators. Original R-N02 refuting probe.
N,N'-di-o-tolylguanidine (DOTG), CAS 97-39-2, rubber vulcanization accelerator, structural analog of DPG. Original R-N02 refuting probe.

1,1,3,3-tetramethylguanidine (TMG), CAS 80-70-6, C5H13N3, MW 115.18. Widely used non-nucleophilic organic superbase catalyst/accelerator in epoxy (anhydride-cure) and polyurethane chemistry. NOT one of R-N02's original 5 probes (DPG, DOTG, guanidine, DICY, biguanide).

2-tert-butyl-1,1,3,3-tetramethylguanidine (Barton's base), CAS 29166-72-1, C9H21N3, MW 171.28. Strong hindered guanidine base/catalyst. NOT one of R-N02's original 5 probes; fully N-substituted (zero N-H by construction) -- tests classification stability when the exclusion rule is not even needed to reach count=0.

1-phenylguanidine, CAS 2002-98-6, C7H9N3, MW 135.17. Mono-aryl guanidine with a free primary NH2 plus imino N-H -- a different substitution pattern (primary amine neighbor) than any of R-N02's original 5 probes, none of which carried a free NH2 on the guanidine carbon.

Agmatine (4-aminobutylguanidine), CAS 306-60-5, C5H14N4, MW 130.19. ADVERSARIAL over-exclusion probe: a molecule with a real, structurally remote primary amine (terminal butyl -NH2, 2 H's, attached to a plain CH2 carbon far from the guanidine carbon) COEXISTING with an incidental guanidine group elsewhere in the same molecule. The R-N02 fix must exclude only the N-H atoms whose OWN attached carbon bears the C=N bond (the guanidine's own 3 N's), not collaterally zero out unrelated amine N-H elsewhere in the molecule. Not tested by R-N02, its refuting receipts, or any other novel probe in this verify -- every other probe here has zero non-guanidine N-H, so none could catch a too-broad, whole-molecule exclusion bug. Pre-registered refute trigger: observed reactive_amine_hydrogen_count != 2 or observed_role != hardener.

reviewer_reference.note: Reviewer key referenced for provenance only; no independent human review performed.

rights_check: No new external data source opened or acquired. All probe molecules are CAS-identified public-domain chemical identities evaluated purely structurally via the already-licensed pinned RDKit backend; the fixture and KPI-test files read are already-in-tree, already-hash-pinned artifacts.
why: Every pre-registered refute trigger was checked and none fired. DPG and DOTG independently re-derive through the real FFI as reactive_amine_hydrogen_count=0 / out_of_domain, matching R-N02's claim. The v1 fixture is byte-intact (sha256 8ce4d54192a20e8de1bb89f6181b11630fc184b4dda2918ce934610630855c8f, matches R-N02's cited value) and all 39 records reproduce via the real FFI. Fixture v2 genuinely supersedes rather than replaces: 44 records total, first 39 structurally identical to v1, v1's file untouched on disk, and the signed Phase-0 KPI harness still binds v1 only -- v2 has not been silently substituted into any signed artifact. All 4 novel guanidine-family probes (TMG, Barton's base, 1-phenylguanidine, agmatine) score exactly as independently predicted, including the adversarial agmatine over-exclusion probe: its remote, non-guanidine-adjacent primary amine retains reactive_amine_hydrogen_count=2 and role=hardener rather than being collaterally zeroed by the presence of an unrelated guanidine group elsewhere in the molecule -- direct evidence the fix's exclusion is correctly scoped per-nitrogen, not per-molecule.
